copy.tagline: 用代码直接操控浏览器完成自动化操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用程序控制浏览器执行重复操作或测试
copy.tagline_en: Control browsers directly via code for automation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for repetitive tasks or testing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能直接控制你的浏览器，自动完成网页操作，比如打开网页、填写表单、截图、抓取数据等。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude执行浏览器相关的任务，例如访问网站、填写表单、截图或自动化操作时触发。

say.text: 打开百度首页并搜索天气
say.note: Claude会启动浏览器执行搜索
Claude会截取浏览器当前页面

say.text: 帮我自动填写登录表单
say.note: Claude会定位表单并输入信息

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can directly control your browser to automate web tasks such as navigating sites, filling forms, taking screenshots, and scraping data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform browser-related tasks, such as visiting a website, filling forms, taking screenshots, or automating actions.

say_en.text: Open Baidu and search for weather
say_en.note: Claude will launch the browser and perform the search

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page
say_en.note: Claude will capture the current browser view
Claude will locate the form and fill in credentials
